subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm: page_alloc: remove ALLOC_NON_BLOCK from ALLOC_RESERVES

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch removes the ALLOC_NON_BLOCK flag from the ALLOC_RESERVES definition in the Linux kernel's page allocation code. The flag was previously used to grant access to a reserve of memory below the minimum watermark, but this caused issues when GFP_NOWAIT allocations were made under memory pressure. By removing the flag, the patch prevents direct reclaim and stalls during such bursts, ensuring that high-order atomic allocations are not disrupted by GFP_NOWAIT consumers. The patch also updates comments in the code to reflect the correct behavior of ALLOC_NON_BLOCK.
